name: Elling Trias
summary: In Stormwind's Trade District, Elling Trias welcomes customers to his family cheese shop. Behind its easy talk, his work as an information broker reaches across continents.

sections.title: The Master Cheesemonger
sections.body: Elling Trias sells fine cheese in the Trade District beside his wife Elaine and son Ben. He offers wheels to customers and chats cheerfully with townsfolk. Yet those who know the shop well understand that Trias' Cheese is also one of Stormwind's most reliable fronts. The city's steady trade lets operatives, courtiers and adventurers exchange quiet words beyond the city watch's notice.

sections.title: A Web of Whispers
sections.body: Elling Trias keeps informants and allies far beyond the reach of most shopkeepers. His ties include Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7, Church contacts such as Bishop DeLavey, and agents in Darkshire, Theramore Isle and the distant Plaguelands near Hearthglen. So when rumors rise of highway bandits or quiet movements in the countryside, Trias often pieces them together before the royal court takes notice.

sections.title: The Missing Diplomat
sections.body: Elling Trias helps investigators search for a high-ranking diplomat who disappeared during a voyage to Theramore. He directs them to his contacts, including an estranged operative named Jorgen and his old friend Tyrion. Their trail reveals the Defias Brotherhood's part in the abduction. Beneath his sharp wit and cynical banter, Elling sees the plot reaching deep into Stormwind's aristocracy.

faq.answer: Elling Trias runs a family cheese shop in Stormwind's Trade District. He is also an experienced information broker, with ties to SI:7, the Church and distant outposts across Azeroth.

faq.q: Where is his cheese shop located?
faq.answer: Trias' Cheese stands in Stormwind City's Trade District, along the outer canal wall near the border with Old Town.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Elling Trias is not a member of the Defias Brotherhood. He tracks their movements through his informant network and helps Alliance adventurers trace their part in plots, including the kidnapping of a royal diplomat.

faq.q: How does he know Mathias Shaw?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw has known Elling Trias for years and turns to him when official channels fail. Shaw hates asking, and Elling grumbles when his work helps Shaw and SI:7. The shop gives them a place for discreet inquiries outside royal channels.

faq.q: Who runs the shop with him?
faq.answer: Elling runs Trias' Cheese with his wife, Elaine Trias, and son, Ben Trias. Together, they keep the shop looking like an ordinary family trade.

faq.q: What is his involvement in the Missing Diplomat investigation?
faq.answer: Bishop DeLavey sends investigators to Elling Trias, whose contacts include old associates Jorgen and Tyrion. Their leads trace Defias movements and reveal who seized the diplomat bound for Theramore.

angles.text: As a rogue, you know a cheese shop can make an ideal drop point. Elling's place near Old Town and his close ties to Mathias Shaw make it a fixture in Stormwind's underworld.
As an Alliance member, you can count on Elling to quietly gather rumors from Theramore to Hearthglen and help guard the realm against threats within.
